Responsibilities include sending follow-up letters and billing, accepting payment on accounts, and using appropriate software to carry out collection and monitoring activities.
cond_0466.responsibilities:
Carry out collection activities to ensure accounts are paid according to contractual payment terms, including accurate billing and prompt collection.
Resolve customer questions, complaints, and requests, which may be varied and complex. Resolution may involve applying advanced knowledge and interpreting policy.
Contact other internal departments or external customers as needed to resolve account issues.
Maintain records on account activities for use in monitoring and analyzing credit files.
Prepare required reports covering the data reported and its impact on the customer and division.
Conduct credit analysis on existing or current customers.
Obtain required information from credit organizations, banks, and loan associations.
cond_0466.requirements:
High school diploma required; some college preferred.
3 Or more years of experience in a customer contact environment.
Familiarity with software in a Windows-based environment and mainframe applications.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to apply and adapt procedures and knowledge to solve problems.
Must be able to operate within designated time constraints to maintain service levels.
